ns2:section.sectionText: Topic: "Contemporary Greek Culture and Film". This course will survey Greek cinema and Greek film culture from the earliest periods to the present and will introduce related developments in modern Greek society with an emphasis on current events. Class-time includes weekly screenings with required attendance. There are no restrictions in enrollment. Media and Film Studies students are welcome. Arrangements can be made for a mixed graduate-undergraduate class. Course meets with GRKM 199, EURO 199, and MACS 199.
